snippet.title: Okashi Towers - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The first teaser/trailler for the new game I am working on as a collaboration (artwork by Shiruht) called Okashi Towers

Okashi Towers is a Halloween themed Real Time Strategy game with Tower Defense elements. Gather candy resources to build tower units or go on offense and summon cute creatures to attack other player bases. Join with up to 8 players and choose one of the four factions that fits your play style best

Wishlist the game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450360/Okashi_Towers/

Follow Shiruht on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Shiruht1

This game is developed in #godot4
